shortDescription: At least 10 people were killed and several others injured in a fire on Saturday at a resort near Inani Beach in Cox's Bazar, a popular tourist destination in southeastern Bangladesh, officials said.

children: At least 10 people were killed and several others injured in a fire on Saturday at a resort near Inani Beach in Cox's Bazar, a popular tourist destination in southeastern Bangladesh, officials said.
The fire broke out at a three-storey wooden resort
The resort was operating without a valid fire safety licence, fire service officials said
A five-member investigation committee has been formed to investigate the cause of the fire
Authorities also said they would examine possible regulatory failures
The incident has raised concerns about fire safety compliance at tourist resorts in the coastal district
